sonnet.problem: The story card just before (card 9) says these are the creatures from Ezekiel's vision 'back where he lived among the exiles in Babylon'. That rules out the wrong 'Jordan River' option and gives away the answer. The same card also calls Ezekiel 1 'his very first vision', which the cited verses don't state.
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.
